notes.title: Fall Update 2018
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26148231/5da240a6388aeaad495506c7aca4c39cb50378f8.png[/img]
Greetings, Detectives!

 It's time for the leaves to turn colors, the wind to whistle through the estate eaves, and for a new murder to solve. Today's update includes a new puzzle to exercise your little grey cells. "Terms of Ensnarement" is available today! Was it Madame Dreary? Don Amore? Or did the innocent little Ward Constance concoct the devious plan? Only you can solve the crime!

 Happy autumn and good sleuthing to you all!

-W&M

notes.title: Holiday Hotfix 12/5/2017
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26148231/831012eed2d09a84e88435eb6a378ef384630f4a.png[/img]
[h1]Make your own list of who’s naughty — and who doesn’t have an alibi…[/h1]

Happy Holidays, Detectives.
It's that time of year again! The holiday [i]A Matter of Murder[/i] content is back -- complete with jingle bells and holiday decor! Enjoy the holiday mysteries while they're here!

Also we've released a Holiday hotfix today with some general improvements and optimizations: 

- Dialogue fixes and narrative tweaks
- Optimizations for older machines
- Fix to optimize frame-rate issues
- Various case fixes

Thanks, everyone! Wishing you all a happy season full of mystery and fun!
-W&M

notes.title: A Matter of Murder Fall Update is Live!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26148231/144c7ce185ecd46b3b297c6b98425a25c5767377.png[/img]

[h1] As Agatha Christie said, “I love the autumn. It’s so much richer than spring.”[/h1] 

We think so too. And we’re delighted to announce that today our fall update goes live with some thrilling new content! 

You'll notice festive decorations around the estate and narrative elements that set the weekend gathering at a Halloween party for the month of October. 

Our new guest at the estate Barrister Harvey RSVP'd and arrived at the estate in full costume!

There's also a new puzzle "Nine Tenths" to test your powers of observation and deduction, as well as eight new achievements for you to unlock.

Additionally, we've created brand new newspaper-clipping themed wallpapers for you to enjoy. Those will be launching separately shortly.

This update also includes other changes and additions:
- Story rewrites and dialogue corrections
- Various bug fixes and improvements

Happy Halloween, Detectives!

notes.title: A Matter of Murder Summer Update is Live!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26148231/80f288402b547e8af680df2921428b365423c031.png[/img]
Happy Bastille Day, Detectives!

Today our summer update goes live with some exciting new content! 
Our new guests at the estate, (voted in by you, our clever sleuths) [b] Miss Herculisa	[/b] and her adorable dog [b] Candyfloss [/b]have been added to guest list!

There's also a new estate to explore [b] The Seaside Villa[/b] complete with a new room, the [b] Veranda.[/b]

We also have a brand new mystery to test your little grey cells titled [b] A Shot in the Dark[/b]. 

Additionally, we're launching special DLC today. The dark and mysterious soundtrack for [i]A Matter of Murder [/i] is now available on Steam:
http://store.steampowered.com/app/676050/A_Matter_of_Murder__Soundtrack/

This update also includes various fixes, changes and additions:
- Achievement bug fixes
- Story rewrites and dialogue corrections
- Introduction character tableau
- Textbox bug fixes

Enjoy the summer, Detectives!
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26148231/f349372f08f492b50bfb9f9b8fa8e342f2514382.png[/img]

notes.title: A Matter of Murder Summer Update to release on July 14th!
notes.content:
Greetings, Detectives.

The game is afoot! Our summer update is just about to launch featuring some exciting new content! 

In addition to various achievement bug fixes, dialogue and story content changes, the update will include a new guest at the estate (Miss Herculisa and her adorable dog Candyfloss), a new mansion to explore (the Seaside Villa) and a new puzzle (A Shot in the Dark). As always, the new content will be made a available free to all current 'Matter of Murder players. 

In addition to the content update, the gorgeously dark and moody soundtrack to [i] A Matter of Murder[/i] will be available as DLC through Steam for $1.99USD. 

Meanwhile, Happy Independence Day to all our American sleuths!
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26148231/04b4a706210cc611c0d4c6e0c417cc37c5d1d3f7.png[/img]
